workspace.description: The workspace the task stands in, by the slug list_workspaces answered: required with a key, and with an id the workspace that must hold the task; leave it out with an id for whichever workspace it stands in.

taskId.description: The task whose relation to move, by the id list_tasks answered, or by its key, such as ACME-42, with the workspace it stands in.

otherTaskId.description: The other task of the relation, in the same workspace, by the id list_tasks answered or by its key.

from.description: How the other task stands to the task now: blocked-by (the other blocks it), blocks (it blocks the other), sub-task (the other is its child), or parent (the other is its parent).

to.description: How the other task stands to the task once moved, in the same words as from, and another kind than from.
